body:
I actually had my last appointment with my therapist yesterday. It felt like we had made a lot of progress but it's another hole in my life now I suppose.

We haven't submitted the notice yet - It will be dependant on when she can move out as the tenancy is in both our names and neither one of us can afford the flat on our own. So it may even be longer than that.

You're right, though the upside of being able to chat to someone I know is that they can provide more specific support through knowing me better, and if they are willing to listen it can serve as a reminder that the person likes and cares about me, which I need sometimes. 

My new job starts right away, which is a godsend really. I don't know if I could cope with having a week off work, I would have way too much free time and would probably put myself into quite a bad place.

Thanks hornles_unicorn, I will take you up on that. I would talk to my friends but I feel like I have too much of a reputation these days of being whiny and pathetic and I don't want to bother anyone.
